title: Signal: Conan requirement pinned to a user channel
scope: A conanfile.txt file that declares a `name/version@user/channel` reference.
limitations: It matches a `name/version@user/channel` reference in the parsed conanfile.txt; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A conanfile.txt that mentions a `name/version@user/channel` reference in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
